projection_consistency.scope: Read-only PostgreSQL and Milvus metadata observations. No app/encoder construction, data writes, alias changes, index creation, repair requests, or further polling.
projection_consistency.certification_result: NOT_PASSED: semantic and hybrid availability failed during unfinished projection maintenance; preserve early baseline separately from current construction state.

postgres.lease_interpretation: The same unfinished build had a valid fenced claim at the last 04:48 observation. Earlier expiry does not establish permanent abandonment. Do not enqueue a duplicate. Owner/token/fence values are intentionally omitted; the owner cannot be tied to an OS PID from these samples alone.

persisted_snapshot.contents: version identifiers only; not an embedding cache

postgres.applied_sequence_semantics: In rebuilding state, begin_rebuild writes applied_seq=snapshot_seq after capturing the authoritative snapshot and persisting version IDs, before external snapshot load and alias switch. Therefore cursor applied_seq=23 does not certify that the active retained Milvus destination has applied through 23. Ordinary ready state also requires exact authority equality.

milvus.interpretation: The retained physical collection and indexes exist, but marker 13 is not authority 29. No current full row/version equivalence audit was performed. Do not relabel marker 13 as 29 or treat the old alias as the latest projection.

readiness.predicate: cursor exists AND status='ready' AND schema_version=3 AND applied_seq=authority watermark
readiness.retrieval_behavior: Current semantic/hybrid path rejects unready projection with the reported HTTP 503; the readiness rejection itself does not demonstrate lost PostgreSQL records or absent Milvus indexes.

pre_restart_projection_failures.interpretation: ProjectionLeaseLost rebuild failures already occurred in the diagnostic process before the normal restart. Do not attribute the first projection failure exclusively to the restart.

data_preservation.normalization: Project payloads onto RecordWrite.model_fields, validate RecordWrite, model_dump(exclude_none=True), then compare canonical JSON. Excludes storage-only embedding_model/version metadata.

source_consistency.interpretation: Files changed after process creation during startup. Actual import times and in-memory module hashes were not inspected; a single frozen normal-process source version cannot be established from filesystem hashes alone. This is a provenance limitation, not proof of data loss or sole causation.

recovery_recommendation_not_executed.immediate_action: Do not enqueue another rebuild or mutate readiness while the observed build has a legal lease. Coordinate with its current owner and freeze source provenance before a fresh certification run.
recovery_recommendation_not_executed.api_precondition: Only after the existing runner is stopped/failed and no valid lease remains; no such action was performed in this audit.
recovery_recommendation_not_executed.api_behavior: Enqueues semantic_index job; handler calls projection_sync.rebuild. begin_rebuild preserves the unfinished build_id and persisted snapshot instead of forcing ready. Existing job retry/resume can be used if a corresponding durable job exists; none was observed for this project.
recovery_recommendation_not_executed.embedding_and_shadow_reuse: No shadow generation was observed. The persisted PostgreSQL snapshot stores version IDs, and repository writes remove embedding from record payloads. Standard load_snapshot prepares all indexed snapshot rows and encodes each row missing embedding in batches of 64; it does not import vectors from the existing alias as a cache. A retry may therefore perform a full 450001-row encoding/load and cannot be advertised as a cheap six-event catch-up. Exact missing-embedding count was not separately queried.
recovery_recommendation_not_executed.lease_failure_evidence: Diagnostic trace contains repeated ProjectionLeaseLost. The inspected store uses 30-second rebuild/delivery leases; full snapshot fetch/materialization precedes later lease renewal, and resume reads all captured versions before the next sync renewal. This explains an exposed lease-expiry seam, but the precise failing statement for every prior exception was not logged.
safety_invariants: Do not switch the old alias as if current
Complete validation/catch-up/alias switch through the coordinator before accepting semantic readiness

runtime_handoff.note: A new ordinary application instance replaced the measured process after the test samples. This recertification did not initiate that replacement. Do not attribute PID49500 warm percentiles or projection state snapshots to PID36216. The reason for the former process exit is not established; this is not evidence of OOM or a service crash.

late_log_evidence.message: canceling statement due to statement timeout
late_log_evidence.interpretation: The full rebuild snapshot record retrieval hit a database statement timeout. This is distinct from observed application RLock waits and does not by itself prove a database lock wait or a hardware cause.

limitations: 正常 HTTP 延迟：固定样例，每类预热后 20 次；最近秩 P95；不代表随机查询分布或更多并发用户。
normal-http-read-v2 在完成所列 20 次采样类别后人为停止更深跳数校准；取消不是 HTTP 业务失败。
全图只有 1 次完整加载；墙钟包含约 92 秒人工/自动化暂停，应同时看约 229 秒活动加载，均超过 30 秒；没有全图 P95。
全图使用正常服务；后台清单和并发检索测试部分时段与全图校准重叠。持续观察期间叠加诊断写入与少量深邻域请求。
3/10 跳各 3 次为并行负载下探索结果，不能作为 20 次独立热测认证。
活动帧指标是受信任鼠标操作附近的 rAF 间隔，并非 GPU 帧耗时；点选计时到基础实体身份可见，不包含后续证据/本体历史加载。
整个浏览器观测窗口还记录了 67 次主线程长任务（P95 91ms、最大 183ms），非活动 rAF 最大间隔 4133.3ms；活动帧达标不等于整个流程绝无停顿。
点选成功样本 P95 单列；1/20 在 15 秒诊断窗口内未观察到所选实体详情身份，计为超时，未与服务日志中的具体请求唯一关联。
JS 堆不是浏览器/显存总占用；RSS 未测，不判通过。浏览器诊断包装有额外开销，最终完整性扫描约 87ms。
诊断服务记录同步阶段耗时与锁归属；嵌套阶段不能相加，driver execute 不能称为纯 SQL 执行时间。
主机与 Docker 为共享资源环境，CPU/内存压力会影响墙钟；交换文件占用不等于发生了换页 I/O。
共享工作区在测试期间存在外部源码更新；已运行的服务无热重载。早期正常服务、诊断服务、最终重启后的复核分别保留 PID 与 OpenAPI 指纹，不把它们当作同一构建的对照实验。
测量结束后服务又从PID49500切换为PID36216（04:50:38启动，04:55:20健康200）；新实例未做性能认证，不将既有P95或维护状态快照归给它。进程退出原因未判定，不能称OOM或崩溃。
04:47:46普通服务日志另记录重建快照records_by_version_ids的PostgreSQL语句超时（QueryCanceled）；它与应用锁等待分别记录，不把全部SQL等待解释成锁表。
本轮只修改专用测试实体并恢复正文及可写字段；修订历史正常增加，不测试所有本体写入/批量导入。
诊断写入的HTTP/CAS校验通过不代表向量追平通过；本轮发现投影rebuilding与水位落后，当前普通服务语义/混合检索为503。
满载观察保留同一图谱会话快照；没有认证外部HTTP修改后前端全图自动增量更新。
本地报告的file协议自动浏览器预览被策略阻止；未尝试替代浏览器或HTTP绕行，采用离线结构、数据与资源链接检查。
合成实体及重复真实模型向量仅用于容量验证，不验证检索相关性、抽取质量或答案质量。
